endorsements.name: Matthew Shannon
endorsements.label: _vti_fpxploitation
endorsements.description: Matthew Shannon is a Senior Associate with KPMG LLP's Risk and Advisory Services(RAS) practice. He has over four years of information technology and security work experience including the technical lead of multiple Network Vulnerability Assessments, Penetration Tests and Incident Response engagements. Matthew graduated cum laude from the University of Florida with a Bachelor of Sciences in Decision and Information Sciences. Matthew is an active contributer to multiple opensource projects, including the Autopsy/TASK forensic toolkit and Honeynet project.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 11

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
